key_test: one-way repeated-measures ANOVA (F1, by subjects), typisch (1 typical / 2 atypical) on per-subject error rate (1 - resp_corr) over the 60 experimental trials
exclusions: none for error rates; RT secondary drops incorrect trials and RT > 1000 ms

r_script.note: even with ez, as written it would fail or mislead: as.numeric(data$Correct) on the string 'True '/'False' gives NA; its ES line prints generalized eta^2 (0.0335 here), not the partial .065 in the table

agreement: Python and table agree (F 1.45, p .242, partial eta^2 .065). R not run (ez missing).
notes: n_after_exclusions counts trials; 22 participants x 60. Anchored on the report's error-rate line and the table's F/p; the RT test (the original's headline effect, whose eta^2 .70 sits in the table's original-effect column) gives F(1,21) = 0.0014, p = .970, typical 499.30 vs atypical 499.53 ms, matching the report. Error rate typical 4.09% vs atypical 2.73%: the predicted direction, not significant. Correct (string) and resp_corr agree on all 1320 trials.
